s1.syndrome_frame: Malocclusion with unerupted tooth and associated radiopaque lesion
salient_findings: Radiopaque lesion in the left mandibular anterior region
key_facts: 22-year-old woman
All permanent teeth erupted except third molars and lower left lateral incisor
Mild spacing between lower left central incisor and canine
Class II, Division 1 malocclusion with crowding in maxillary anterior region
No history of prior dental extractions
Panoramic radiograph and mandibular occlusal film showed unerupted lower left lateral incisor
Radiopaque lesion surrounded by thin radiolucent halo
Lesion obstructs eruption path of lower left lateral incisor

differentials: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor associated with an unerupted tooth
Odontoma associated with a supernumerary tooth
per_call: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor associated with an unerupted tooth
Odontoma associated with a supernumerary tooth

shortlist.label: Compound odontoma
shortlist.why_kept: Radiopaque lesion with well-defined borders and association with an unerupted tooth

shortlist.label: Complex odontoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar radiographic appearance to compound odontoma, possible cause of tooth impaction

shortlist.label: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Commonly associated with unerupted teeth and can cause tooth impaction

shortlist.label: Dentigerous cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause tooth impaction and has a radiographic appearance consistent with the case

shortlist.label: Odontogenic keratocyst
shortlist.why_kept: Can cause tooth impaction and has a radiographic appearance consistent with the case

raw.rationale: The presence of a well-defined radiopaque lesion surrounded by a thin radiolucent halo obstructing the eruption path of the lower left lateral incisor is consistent with an odontoma, and the compound type is more likely given the description of a single lesion associated with an unerupted tooth.

rejected.label: Complex odontoma
rejected.why: Typically presents as a single, large, radiopaque mass, which does not match the description of a well-defined lesion associated with an unerupted tooth.

rejected.label: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor
rejected.why: Often associated with an unerupted tooth but typically presents as a radiolucent lesion with radiopacities, not a well-defined radiopaque lesion.

rejected.label: Dentigerous cyst
rejected.why: Characterized by a radiolucent lesion surrounding the crown of an unerupted tooth, which does not match the radiopaque lesion described.

rejected.label: Odontogenic keratocyst
rejected.why: Typically presents as a radiolucent lesion, which does not match the radiopaque lesion described in the case.
